The current O(n^2) becomes O(n log n) with a sort-then-two-pointer sweep:
```python
def find_pair(nums, target):
    seen = {}
    for i, n in enumerate(nums):
        if target - n in seen:
            return (seen[target - n], i)
        seen[n] = i
    return None
```
The dict lookup runs in expected O(1) so the whole pass is O(n).
